The problem

How to compare multifamily agencies for AI search

01Ask what they work on. AI answers tend to draw on your Google Business Profile, reviews, website and listings, so ask how the agency keeps each one accurate and active.
02Ask which AI tools they check. ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can give different answers to the same renter question.
03Ask for apartment proof: a community they market, with leasing numbers from before and after.
04Ask how often you get a report, and what is in it. Calls, direction requests and website clicks show whether renters acted on what they found.
05Ask about guarantees. No agency controls how AI tools answer, so be careful with any promise of a guaranteed spot.
Apartment proofHuxley Scottsdale: 192 luxury homes in North Scottsdale. 52% leased the day we took over, 88% leased as of November 2026. Read the case study at thesocialdm.com/huxley-case-study.

What is AI search for apartments?

Renters now ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI which apartments to tour. AI search work helps your community come up accurately in those answers.

Can an agency guarantee my community shows up in ChatGPT?

No. AI tools change how they answer and no agency controls them. An agency can keep your Google listing, reviews, website and social presence accurate and active, and report what renters do as a result.
